name: Cable characterization
description: Loss of an RF cable against frequency with a vector network analyzer (VNA): insertion loss in dB (and per metre), loss at chosen frequencies, group delay and velocity factor, return loss, and a pass / fail check against a limit. The VNA is calibrated beforehand by the user.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated at the ends of the test leads

mode.description: transmission: cable between port 1 and port 2 (S21); reflection: one end on port 1 and an open or short on the other (S11)

termination.description: reflection only: what is on the far end of the cable

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

cable.description: label (identifies the cable), asset_id (its code in the registry) and length_m (gives dB/m and the velocity factor)

frequencies_of_interest.description: the loss is reported at these frequencies

limits.description: pass / fail limit on the loss in dB: {"max": 1.5} or a line or bands (see ola/limits.py)

also_s11.description: transmission only: also read S11 to report the return loss of the cable

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good cable of the same kind): name (in the golden/ folder of the project) or run (a run file), and tolerances = {curves: [{trace, view, tolerance}], summary: {figure: tolerance}, min_overlap}

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the cable
